# Packages the weekly dependency upgrade leaves at their locked versions.
#
# These are the model clients, agent frameworks, tracing libraries and the suggestor itself. A
# version bump in any of them can change model output or what gets traced, which would move eval
# scores for reasons unrelated to the change being evaluated. Each moves only in its own pull
# request, with an eval run before and after, as docs/dependency-upgrades.md describes.
#
# One package name per line; a trailing * matches a prefix.
anthropic
openai
google-genai
claude-agent-sdk
llm
llm-anthropic
llm-claude-3
llm-gemini
llm-matrix
langfuse
openinference-*
nmdc-metadata-suggestor-ai-tool
